::: {#def-markov-chain}
#### Markov chain

A sequence of random variables $\vparam^{(1)}, \vparam^{(2)}, \ldots$
is a **Markov chain** if, for every $t$,
the conditional distribution of $\vparam^{(t+1)}$ given all the earlier values
depends only on $\vparam^{(t)}$:

$$
\p\paren{\vparam^{(t+1)} \mid \vparam^{(t)}, \vparam^{(t-1)}, \ldots, \vparam^{(1)}}
=
\p\paren{\vparam^{(t+1)} \mid \vparam^{(t)}}.
$$
:::
